text.tspan: 1. The user should raise a payment request.
2. Each payment request should have a dedicated, unique session (idempotent requests).
3. System should support multiple payment methods, i.e., UPI, Cards, etc.
4. Payment should have a proper life cycle (Created, Processing, Completed, Failed, Refunded).
5. There should be a transaction status tracking option for each payment.
6. Merchants should be notified once the payment is done (webhook triggers).
1. The system should be highly available outside the transaction.
2. Each transaction should be idempotent and highly consistent (no double payments or wrong life cycle flow).
4. Client details should be secured (PCI-DSS compliance).
Clients do shopping on merchant's site/app
Merchants raise payment request to Payment Gateway
Forward request to those 3rd party services based on
Update merchant when the payment is successful
Clients do shopping on merchant's site/app
Merchants raise payment request to Payment Gateway
Forward request to those 3rd party services based on
Mark debit entry in case of transaction failure
Update merchant when the payment is successful/failed
